91    /**
92     * Generates a valid random AVS13 (swiss social security) number
93     *
94     * This function will generate a valid random AVS13 number and return it
95     * as a formatted string.
96     *
97     * @see https://www.zas.admin.ch/zas/fr/home/partenaires-et-institutions-/navs13.html
98     *
99     * @return string
100     */
101    public static function avs13()
102    {
103        $p = [
104            756,
105            self::numerify('####'),
106            self::numerify('####'),
107            self::numerify('#'),
108        ];
109
110        $checksum = \Faker\Calculator\Ean::checksum(implode('', $p));
111
112        return sprintf('%s.%s.%s.%s%s', $p[0], $p[1], $p[2], $p[3], $checksum);
113    }
